failed.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies revolver and term loan priority/pari passu question
failed.reasoning: Neither the memo nor the draft flags whether the $55M revolver ranks ahead of or pari passu with the $310M term loan; the waterfall just defers to the FL CA ordering.

failed.title: ISSUE_004: Flags risk of automatic release enabling uptier/Serta-style transactions
failed.reasoning: Nothing flags the risk that the automatic release could enable uptier, Serta-style or non-pro-rata transactions.

failed.title: ISSUE_004: Considers anti-Serta protections for automatic release
failed.reasoning: There are no anti-uptier protections (non-affiliate sale, ratable benefit) and no reference to Serta or Boardriders; the only proviso covers releases on a payoff/discharge.

failed.title: ISSUE_006: Flags enforceability risk of complete adequate protection cash payment waiver
failed.reasoning: The adequate protection cash waiver in 6.3(c) is drafted 'without hedging', and no note flags enforceability risk under Sections 361/363(e)/364 or cites authority.

failed.title: ISSUE_006: Recommends savings clause or limitation rather than complete waiver
failed.reasoning: No savings clause or softening is drafted or recommended for the adequate protection waiver; the enforceability backstop in 6.5(d) covers plan voting only.

failed.title: ISSUE_010: Notes second lien does not include hedging/cash management
failed.reasoning: No note says the Second Lien Obligations exclude hedging or cash management; the related note concerns the SL CA's definition of First Lien Obligations instead.
